_comment: Enterprise (production) mode with an OIDC provider. Secrets/IDs are injected from env vars (${...}) so this file is safe to commit. Provide them via a gitignored .env.local and run: set -a && source .env.local && set +a && GATEWAY_CONFIG=./config/gateway.oidc.json npm start. Register the redirect URI <publicUrl>/auth/callback/azure in your IdP. authorization is OFF so any authenticated user is treated as admin — turn it on + add role bindings (config/policy.csv) for real RBAC.
